entries.summary: More reliable clipboard history shared from your Mac.
changes: The Mac app now uploads the saved clipboard item when you copy existing content again, avoiding duplicate cloud records in your shared history.
Clipboard diagnostic messages now avoid exposing clipboard text and sensitive error details.

entries.summary: Safer local history and more reliable iCloud downloads.
changes: Downloaded clipboard changes are saved locally before iCloud progress is advanced, so a failed save can be retried without skipping items.
Clipboard history is preserved when storage encounters a runtime failure.

entries.summary: Downloaded history remembers its sync state.
changes: Items downloaded from iCloud remain marked as synced when saved locally, avoiding unnecessary uploads.
